title: Design tokens audit, component wireframes and backlog grooming — console
summary: Working notes from a rapid audit of console design tokens, a set of low-fidelity wireframe adjustments for the component library, and a prioritized grooming pass on related backlog items. Intended audience: design system maintainers, frontend engineers, and product PMs. This is a living doc — many items are hypotheses that need engineering verification and accessibility testing.
background: Motivation: inconsistencies between Console CSS tokens and the component library are causing visual drift across routes and make canary rollouts riskier. Recent customer feedback called out focus states and contrast on key CTA buttons. We want to reduce variance, centralize tokens, and ensure accessible defaults before the next release window.
high_level_findings: Color tokens duplicated in two places: legacy --surface-XX and newer surface. Leads to mismatch when swapping themes.
Spacing scale is inconsistent: some components use 4px base, others 8px base; leads to layout jitter in autoscaling pages.
Button focus outlines are disabled in production CSS reset; keyboard users cannot reliably discover interactive controls.
Form field labels use <div> wrappers in a few legacy components which breaks label-for semantics.
A11y tests currently only run in CI for new PRs; regression window still too wide — need focused storybook checks.
wireframe_notes: Sidebar: reduce visual weight by moving from 1px hard border to subtle elevation token (elevation-2) and increasing left padding to token-space-4.
Settings page: group toggles into cards with consistent 16px internal padding (token-space-4) and add a compact vertical rhythm option for power users.
Model selector modal: add badge for 'recommended' models and explicit keyboard nav order; suggested wireframe includes top-left close, top-right model-filter menu, and primary CTAs bottom-right.
Alert banners: wireframe proposes icon + 12px gap + content; ensure icons use aria-hidden and text has role=status for screen readers.
Route-level header: move secondary actions into overflow menu to keep header accessible at small widths.
Wireframe sketches saved in Figma: see linked artifacts; use these as basis for Storybook stories.
accessibility_findings: Primary CTA color contrast falls to 3.9:1 on some themes (target 4.5:1 for normal text); propose color swap or bold token for small text.
Missing focus-visible outlines: global reset hides outlines; add .focus-ring token via focus-visible polyfill and restore for keyboard users.
Incorrect semantic markup: several items using role=button but not keyboard-activatable; convert to <button> or add keydown handlers and tabindex where appropriate.
Icon-only buttons lack aria-labels in batch of widgets; add automated lint rule to require aria-label or aria-labelledby.
Dynamic content updates (live transcriptions) are not announced; add aria-live=\"polite\" region for status updates.
component_library_changes: Introduce standardized Button variants: primary, secondary, ghost, muted. Map existing classes to these tokens and deprecate legacy classes over 2 sprints.
TextInput: enforce label wrapping with <label> and data-qa attributes for testing. Add helperText slot with optional aria-describedby hookup.
Card: unify shadow/elevation usage to use elevation-2 token; remove bespoke box-shadow CSS from 6 components.
IconButton: require aria-label; build lint rule in eslint-plugin-redwood to catch violations.
Create Storybook stories for each variant with a11y checks included (keyboard navigation + contrast tests).
token_recommendations: Colors: consolidate duplicate tokens (e.g., --surface-700 -> surface-700). Add alias map to avoid breaking changes and plan removal in vNext.
Spacing: standardize on 4px base scale (space-1=4px, space-2=8px, space-4=16px) and migrate components incrementally.
Typography: define scale tokens for heading/body/small with explicit line-heights and font-weights to reduce visual shift when swapping locales.
Motion: add motion-reduce token and use prefers-reduced-motion media query across all micro-interactions.
Focus: new token focus-ring-color and focus-ring-width (3px on high-contrast backgrounds) to be used globally.

decisions: Adopt 4px spacing base; perform migration via codemods over two release cycles.
Introduce focus-ring token and re-enable visible outlines for keyboard users by default.
Deprecate legacy color variables with aliasing layer to prevent immediate breakage.
Prioritize accessibility fixes before cosmetic token renames when there is a choice.

risks_and_questions: Migration churn: many small components need manual touch; consider temporary compatibility CSS to limit release surface.
Theme variance: enterprise customers have custom themes that may break with token renames; plan a deprecation window and communication.
Performance: adding focus outlines and extra aria attributes should be low cost, but need smoke testing on low-end devices.
Do we want automatic codemods in repo or a migration guide? Recommendation: both — codemods for common cases, guide for edge cases.
next_steps: 1) Finalize migration plan PR (Marcus). 2) Create Storybook a11y pipeline ticket and schedule a 2-week spike to bake tests. 3) Run a small internal canary (dev cluster) with focus changes and measure regressions. 4) Review customer theme compatibility list and add compatibility checks to release playbook.
